scope: 50 formerly demo-priced dry Leonardo pack variants plus 2 previously priced variants, covering all 52 dry Leonardo variants visible in CatManDog
method: Public Spanish consumer retail prices for exact recipe and single pack, checked 2026-10-17. LEONARDO product:price metadata, visible Miscota single-unit offers, and Amazon.es exact-pack product pages with add-to-cart availability. Kiwoko site search was checked but no exact Leonardo offer could be confirmed. Exclude multipacks, subscriptions, coupons, historic prices, supplier quotations and shipping. Prices include IVA.
selectedPriceRule: Display the highest verified public consumer price for the exact recipe and single pack among LEONARDO, Miscota and Amazon.es; Kiwoko contributes only when an exact offer is found. This remains a temporary market reference, not a CatManDog selling price or purchase price.
